profile.products: Electrical Americas: electrical & industrial components, power distribution & assemblies, residential, single/three-phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution (incl. Cooper Power series transformers, voltage regulators), power reliability equipment & services, produced/sold mainly in North & South America (2025 10-K). Transformers: three-phase transformers made at two Wisconsin facilities incl. Waukesha WI (Cooper Power series product line); new Jonesville SC three-phase transformer plant ($340M, production from 2027); voltage regulators at Nacogdoches TX. Solid-state transformer technology via Resilient Power Systems (acq. 2025-08-06, EA). Electrical Global: same product families outside the Americas + hazardous-duty/emergency lighting; 49% equity stake in Jiangsu Ryan Electrical (power distribution & sub-transmission transformers, China). Eaton is a diversified power-management company; transformers are a minority of Electrical Americas sales (no separate disclosure).
